clearedSpotChecks.note: Read src/PoolManager.sol:279-288: sync has no onlyWhenUnlocked modifier and stores the currency and balanceOfSelf through CurrencyReserves.syncCurrencyAndReserves (src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:27-32). _settle at src/PoolManager.sol:349-364 reads the synced currency and reserves by TLOAD, pays reservesNow - reservesBefore and resets the currency.
